notes.title: Warriors Abyss hits its lowest price yet as roguelike spinoff drops major update
notes.content:
It's no secret that I love a good musou game, and Dynasty Warriors: Origins quickly became a personal favorite of mine when it launched earlier this year. Then, mere weeks later, publisher Koei Tecmo shadow-dropped a Vampire Survivors-inspired spinoff called Warriors Abyss, which captured my roguelike-loving heart. Thanks to a deep discount and a major update, now's the perfect time to take it for a spin.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The master ninja Ryu Hayabusa and 3 allies join the fight!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LDhfUQGLAmQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We are proud to release an update for the popular rougelite Warriors action game "WARRIORS: Abyss"  available now. This update includes an additional 4 characters, including the legendary master ninja Ryu Hayabusa and 3 of his companions, new features and downloadable content featuring a variety of costumes.

With this update, aside from Ryu Hayabusa, Ayane, Rachel, and Momiji from the same universe will become playable characters. The addition of these characters, each possessing unique abilities, will further expand the range of strategic options available to players.
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493133/d709d13eee8fadaf902b0fd3ddb6fbd1f5b123a7.jpg[/img][/p]
Furthermore, this update introduces two new game modes designed to create more enjoyable gameplay. The first mode, "Training Hall," challenges players to defeat Gouma under various conditions. Upon clearing it for the first time, players will receive rewards such as Karma Embers, Records of Sin, and an increase in the cumulative level cap. The second mode, "Void of Empathy," is a time-limited challenge where players strive to progress as far as possible before the timer runs out. Players must defeat powerful enemies to extend their time since the game ends when the remaining time reaches zero, pushing their skills to the limit.

Additionally, we have implemented a "Transcendence" feature, which significantly enhances heroes. Although it requires a lot of Karma Embers, this feature adds new emblems to heroes with few and alters the effects of their unique strategies that were previously limited in use. These enhancements are tailored to each hero, expanding strategic options. Since during use stats also increase, it’s a great help when attempting to clear high Traversal Levels.

[h3][b]New Game Mode "Void of Ephemerality " Added![/b][/h3]
“The Depths and the Void" has been added to the Great Hall, from which players can select either "Depths of Torment" or " Void of Ephemerality." "Void of Ephemerality" is a mode where players challenge themselves to progress as far as possible within a limited time. To play, you need "Soul Records," which can be saved on the results screen after defeating Gouma once. Your performance in " Void of Ephemerality," will determine the amount of Records of Sins and Karma Embers you can earn.
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493133/a830da5c1f93f0c2e2c3bd2ae0220978cccc0555.png[/img][/p]
[h3][b]New Game Mode "Training Hall" Added![/b][/h3]
"Training Hall" is a mode where players aim to defeat Gouma under various conditions. Players are required to have defeated Gouma once to unlock this mode. Players can challenge themselves up to the highest traversal level achieved in normal mode and upon clearing each level they receive first-time clear rewards.

[h3][b]"Transcendence" Feature Added![/b][/h3]
By using Karma Embers on heroes whom you have unlocked unique weapons in the Hall of Bonded Souls, you can perform a "Transcendence" to further enhance the hero's abilities. The "Transcendence" can also be undone, and in that case, all used Karma Embers will be returned.

[h3][b]Ryu Hayabusa[/b][/h3]
An unprecedented hero possessing three "Shinobi" emblems. His unique strategy, "The Dragon Ninja," increases the speed and attack rate of the controlled hero by 15%, an effect that applies to all heroes, making him valuable in any build. His Player Hero Trait, "Solitary Master Ninja," boosts the number of possessed "Speed" emblems by 50%, and with the unique weapon "Evil God Sealing Demon," the number of possessed "Vigor" emblems is also increased by 50%, making it significantly easier to gather the two types of emblems. His Summoning Skill, "Art of the Inferno," transforms fireballs into the form of a dragon when strengthening conditions are met, delivering powerful repeated attacks to surrounding enemies.

With excellent usability both as a controlled hero and a summoned hero, he truly lives up to the name "master ninja " and is expected to perform outstandingly.
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493133/7742e980f1a63383ebb7bf694a7ec24473b7c5e0.png[/img][/p]
[h3][b]Ayane[/b][/h3]
The Unique Strategy "Mugen Tenshin Style" increases the attack power of heroes possessing the "Speed" emblem by 50%. Its effect applies to a wide range of heroes, and since heroes with the "Shinobi" emblem almost always have the "Speed" emblem, this ability serves as a core asset when building a ninja-themed team.

[h3][b]Rachel[/b][/h3]
The Unique Strategy "Fiend Blood" doubles the attack power of heroes possessing the "Might" emblem. This ability is especially beneficial for “Independent”  heroes such as "Meng Huo" and "Okuni." The Summoning Skill "Heavy Machine Gun" is a distinctive attack that fires numerous lightning-element bullets in a fan-shaped area in front of the user.

[h3][b]Momiji[/b][/h3]
The Unique Strategy "Heaven Breaker" increases attack power by 5% for each "Speed" emblem possessed. It is expected to perform well in "Speed" builds centered around strengthened "Speed" emblems. The Summoning Skill "Heavensong Bow" fires fire-element arrows that bounce off obstacles.

[h3][b]DLC[/b][/h3]
In addition, as paid downloadable content, we are offering the MASTER NINJA Formal Costume Set and the MASTER NINJA Legacy Costume Set, featuring characters dressed in unique outfits. Enjoy a different style of combat with these distinctive costumes.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.4.0 on Jul. 04, 2025)
notes.content:
[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]
- Added the new heroes Ryu Hayabusa, Ayane, Rachel, and Momiji.
- Added the new game mode Training Hall.
[quote]Note that to challenge yourself in the Training Hall, you must have already defeated Gouma at least once.
The highest Traversal Level you can attempt in the Training Hall is the max Level where you have defeated Gouma with any hero in normal playthroughs.
You can also obtain a First Completion Reward for each Traversal Level completed in the Training Hall.
[/quote]- Added the new game mode Void of Ephemerality.
[quote]The option "The Depths and the Void" will be added to the Great Hall, and from there you can select either the Depths of Torment or the Void of Ephemerality.
Note that to challenge yourself in the Void of Ephemerality, you must first defeat Gouma and save your stats as a Soul Record on the Results screen.
Depending on the results of your run in the Void of Ephemerality, you can also obtain Records of Sin.
[/quote]- Added the timed battle mode Void of Ephemerality in response to high demand from players.
[quote]Unlike in the Depths of Torment, Trials triggered during each Phase in the Void of Ephemerality will not weaken the player hero. The game will end when the time runs out, but the time limit will be extended slightly each time you defeat powerful enemies like One-eyed Ogres, so you'll have to use more aggressive strategies to achieve victory.
To make it more beneficial to complete difficult missions where you fight strong enemies like One-eyed Ogres in the Depths of Torment, we have added treasure chests with additional Spirit Essence that appear only after the mission is complete.
You can obtain Records of Sin based on the amount of Spirit Essence you have acquired in both of these modes, giving you the freedom to select whichever play style is more enjoyable for you.
[/quote]- Made it possible to activate Transcendence, a feature allowing you to upgrade your heroes to even greater heights.
[quote]In the Hall of Bonded Souls, you can expend Karma Embers to activate Transcendence for heroes whose Unique Weapons have been unlocked. You can also deactivate Transcendence, which will return all of your expended Karma Embers.

Transcendence is a new element added in response to requests for ways to permanently upgrade heroes.
While it costs a large amount of Karma Embers, it enables upgrades in the form of additional Emblems for heroes with fewer Emblems, changes to Unique Tactics with limited usability, and expansions to strategy based on each hero's unique characteristics. It will also offer status enhancements, so activating it can be a strategic way to challenge yourself in Traversal Levels that were once too difficult to complete. Deactivating Transcendence will also reimburse all of your expended Karma Embers.
Activate Transcendence for a variety of heroes to see how it benefits you the most.
[/quote]- Made it possible raise a hero's Cumulative Level by expending Karma Embers in the Hall of Bonded Souls.
[quote]This feature was also added in response to player requests.
When the Cumulative Level is increased to certain points, the hero's status will also increase. This affects the amount of damage dealt by summonable heroes when their Summoning Skill is activated, which increases the Cumulative Levels of various heroes whenever you attempt difficult Traversal Levels, giving you an edge in battle.
[/quote]- Added six tracks to Music in the Collection menu, all of which are unlocked from the start.
- Added the resolutions listed below as possible options for the Steam version of the game.
[quote]• 2560 × 1080
• 3440 × 1440
• 3840 × 1600
[/quote]
[h3][b]Adjustments/Improvements[/b][/h3]
- Increased Attack by 50% for heroes with Unique Weapons, regardless of whether they are the player hero or a summonable hero.
[quote]In the previous update, there was a bug that increased Attack by 100% regardless of whether the required conditions had been fulfilled if you had Player Hero Traits, Unique Tactics, or Records of Sin with the following effects:
• Increases Attack by 〇〇% towards enemies with Burn.
• Increases Attack by 〇〇% towards enemies with Freeze.
• Increases Attack by 〇〇% towards enemies with Shock.
• Increases Attack by 〇〇% towards enemies with Disorient.
This bug significantly affected the balance of game stats and also greatly widened the gap between heroes' ability levels. In fixing this bug, the play feel will change greatly for heroes like Ginchiyo Tachibana and Mature Yukimura Sanada, who were added in the previous update and whose Traits include those listed above.
For this reason, we have fixed the bug, but we have also made changes so that Attack will increase by 50% for all heroes whose Unique Weapon has been acquired and by 100% when Transcendence is activated.
[/quote]- Made the following adjustments in regard to King's Cauldrons:
[quote]• King's Cauldrons now appear after the defeat of Level Bosses in the Desolate Expanse.
• The number of heroes who appear at King's Cauldrons will not decrease for Traversal Level 2 and above.
• The amount of Tears of Blood paid at King's Cauldrons at each Traversal Level has been adjusted.

Previously, there were cases where King's Cauldron portals never appeared during a single playthrough, giving the player no chance to spend their hard-earned Tears of Blood before the game ended. Therefore, we made adjustments so that a King's Cauldron will always appear after a Level Boss has been defeated in the Desolate Expanse.
Additionally, because fewer heroes appeared at King's Cauldrons in higher Traversal Levels, it became less beneficial to choose King's Cauldron portals and or to activate Traits and Unique Tactics that provide Tears of Blood. For this reason, we made adjustments to prevent a decrease in heroes appearing across all Traversal Levels.
[/quote]- Made the following adjustments to portals:
[quote]• Karma Embers and Tears of Blood no longer appear in the phase immediately after a Level Boss.
• The amount of Karma Embers you can acquire at Karma Ember portals has increased. The higher the Traversal Level, the greater the amount of Karma Embers.
[/quote]- Unified Traversal Level progress for all heroes so that if one hero has completed a Level, then any hero can attempt the next Level.
- Made it possible to raise the max Cumulative Level via the First Completion Bonus in the Training Hall. When a hero reaches certain Cumulative Levels above 500, their Movement Speed will permanently increase.
- Made changes so that your Cumulative Level will increase more after you have completed Traversal Level 1 and above.
[quote]Made it easier to increase the Cumulative Level now that the max Cumulative Level has been raised.
[/quote]- Added a fourth Increase Reroll Chances to the Enma's Blessings that can be unlocked in the Hall of Bonded Souls.
- Made it less likely for the same hero to appear multiple times in a row when rerolling at a Crystal Sapling.
- Increased the limit for how many Karma Embers you can possess from 999,999 to 9,999,999.
- Adjusted the Effect Upgrades that can be obtained through "Vigor," "Skill," and "Speed" Emblems.
- Upgraded the Effect Upgrade "Launch Slashes" for the "Vigor" Emblem.
- Adjusted the amount of damage dealt with Summoning Skills.
- Adjusted the effects of the following treasures:
[quote]• Cherry Blossom Armor
• Bow of Yang Youji
• Ranjatai Agarwood
• Compass
• Green Bag Book
• Painting of Kannon
• Imperial Seal
• Abacus
• Bronze Bird
• Book of the Art of Concealment
• The Six Secret Teachings
[/quote]- Adjusted the upgrade conditions for Okuni's Summoning Skill.
- Adjusted the effects of Wei Yan's Unique Tactic "Defiant Blade."
- Added Zhang Jiao's "Yellow Turbans" Emblem.
- Reduced the barrier gauge for the Level Boss Onigashira under the normal difficulty.
- Reduced the barrier gauge for the Level Bosses Tamahami and Gouma in Traversal Level 6.
- Reduced Gouma's Attack when he appears under certain conditions in Traversal Level 6.
- Adjusted the Summoning Skill damage reduction for special barriers that defend against Summoning Skills.
- Made changes so your Cumulative Level will increase even when you have leveled up in the Depths of Torment.
- Made changes so that treasure chests will appear after you have completed missions to defeat strong enemies in the Depths of Torment. These treasure chests may include Spirit Essence.
- Reduced the amount of Karma Embers needed to obtain Records of Sin from the second record on.
[quote]Because the implementation of "Transcendence" and "Cumulative Level Increase via Karma Embers" have led to an increased demand for Karma Embers, we have greatly reduced the number of Karma Embers needed to obtain Records of Sin from the second record on. We also made it possible to convert Records of Sin into Karma Embers at a later point, depending on the rank of the Records of Sin you acquire, which allows you more freedom in selecting Records of Sin.

notes.title: A New Level and Elements That Become Available After Clearing Arrive!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493133/9c9a5c1c1e67b34ad4e17681d8713c183199c511.png[/img]
This update introduces two features that allow you to challenge yourself at even higher difficulty levels. The first is the addition is "Traversal Level 6," which you can take on with characters with which you have cleared Traversal Level 5 with more stringent conditions. While playing at Traversal Level 6, meeting certain conditions allows you to challenge a new form of the final boss. The second element is a new game mode called "Depths of Torment," which is unlocked after beating the game once. This mode is a high-difficulty mode designed for players who have completed the game, allowing them to challenge a new hell alongside the heroes from the regular mode. Depending on your results, you can earn a new item called "Records of Sin," so be sure to give it a try! Additionally, as a new feature unlocked after clearing the game, we've added "Change Music," which allows you to freely set the playlist of songs played on each floor. The selection of songs increases as you earn more "Achievements."

Additionally, with this update, characters from the "SAMURAI WARRIORS" series, including Mature Yukimura Sanada, Chacha, Ginchiyo Tachibana, Muneshige Tachibana, Yoshihiro Shimazu, Toyohisa Shimazu, and Motochika Chosokabe, will be added as playable characters. The inclusion of these characters, each with unique abilities, will further expand the range of strategies available.

[h3][b]Traversal Level 6 Added![/b][/h3]
With heroes who have cleared Traversal Level 5, you can challenge even stricter conditions for completion. Additionally, after clearing certain sections, the "Thorns of Fixation" will appear, and by pulling three of these, you can challenge the new form of the final boss.

[h3][b]New game-mode "Depths of Torment" implemented![/b][/h3]
This mode allows you to save your heroes from when you clear the normal mode and challenge a new higher-difficulty hell with them. This hell is endlessly deep, and even heroes who have defeated the Gouma will find it challenging to conquer. Depending on the results of your run, you can earn a new item called the "Record of Sin," which can be used for character growth. Assemble what you believe to be the strongest team and challenge this hell as many times as you’d like!

[h3][b]"Change Music" feature added![/b][/h3]
Once you clear the game in normal mode, this feature is unlocked, allowing you to freely set the playlist of songs played on each level. The selection of available songs can be expanded by earning "Achievements."

[h3][b]Seven characters from” SAMURAI WARRIORS” arrive![/b][/h3]
Seven new heroes will be added: “Mature Yukimura Sanada,” “Chacha,” “Ginchiyo Tachibana,” “Muneshige Tachibana,” “Yoshihiro Shimazu,” “Toyohisa Shimazu,” and “Motochika Chosokabe.”

[b]Mature Yukimura Sanada[/b]
The Unique Strategy "Japan's Greatest Warrior" has strict activation conditions, but it increases the attack power of heroes with the Emblems "Sanada," "Skill," and "Wisdom" by 100%. Additionally, the Player Hero Trait "Sanada's Strategies" boosts attack power against enemies in a burning state by 50%. Furthermore, every six levels, it grants one of the emblems, making it a powerful ability. Note that since this character is the same as the regular Yukimura Sanada, if you control or form an alliance with one, the other will not appear.

[b]Chacha[/b]
The Unique Strategy "Proud Princess" increases the defense of heroes with the emblems "Toyotomi" and "Azai" by 70%. Its activation conditions are easy to meet, significantly enhancing stability from the early to mid-game. The emblems possessed are also applicable to Mature Yukimura Sanada's Unique Strategy, and the activation conditions can be fulfilled, making them highly compatible.

[b]Ginchiyo Tachibana[/b]
The Unique Strategy "Sword of Lightning" can increase Bolt emblems’ attack power by 100%, making it a powerful effect that is highly desirable for builds centered around the "Bolt" emblem.

[b]Muneshige Tachibana[/b]
The Unique Strategy "Bravest Warrior of Chinzei" increases the attack power of heroes with the emblems "Western Region" and "Strength" by 50%. Since it affects a wide range of heroes, it is expected to be useful in various situations.

[b]Yoshihiro Shimazu[/b]
The Unique Strategy "Demon Shimazu" increases the attack power against enemy barriers by 100% for heroes with the "Western Region" emblem, making it highly effective when playing with heroes from the "Western Region."

[b]Toyohisa Shimazu[/b]
The Unique Strategy "Sacrificial Gambit" increases the attack power against enemy barriers by 100% for heroes with the "Master Gunner" Emblem. Since he and Yoshihiro Shimazu are mutually affected by each other's Unique Strategies, deploying both simultaneously is effective.

[b]Motochika Chosokabe[/b]
The Unique Strategy "Music of the Young Demon" increases attack power by 100% during Assemble. The activation requires the emblems "Skill" and "Speed," without needing any special emblems, and its effect applies to any hero, making it versatile for any formation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493133/b4530998b389041709af58abff75ea3730c46079.png[/img]

[h3][b]DLC[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493133/ce748defd540851308a0e29df6ef54ccc35666dc.jpg[/img]
As DLC, we are offering the "SAMURAI WARRIORS" Western Japan Classic Costume Set (seven types) and the "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION” Yukimura Sanada Costume Set (two types), which allow you to use characters dressed in different out
fits. Enjoy battles with a fresh twist, thanks to these unique costumes.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.3.0 on Apr. 25, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
- Added the new heroes Mature Yukimura Sanada, Chacha, Ginchiyo Tachibana, Muneshige Tachibana, Yoshihiro Shimazu, Toyohisa Shimazu, and Motochika Chosokabe.
- Added the new mode the Depths of Torment. To challenge yourself in the Depths of Torment, you must first apply the update, defeat Gouma once, and then save your Soul Record on the results screen. You can obtain a new type of item, the Records of Sin, based on the results of your run in the Depths of Torment.
- Added Traversal Level 6, during which you can trigger new conversations with Enma by fulfilling certain conditions.
- Added the function Change Music, which will be made available once Gouma has been defeated. This function enables you to change the playlist of music for each Level of Hell, with more songs being unlocked as you fulfil conditions for Achievements.
- Added 9 songs to Music under Collection. These songs will now be available from the start of the game.

[b]Adjustments/Improvements[/b]
- Added a third Increase Reroll Chances to the Enma's Blessings that can be unlocked in the Hall of Bonded Souls.
- Made slight adjustments to the Player Hero Trait effect for Diaochan's and Zhang Chunhua's Unique Weapons.
  Before: Replenishes 20% of your Health after every 1,000 enemies defeated.
  After: Replenishes 1% of your Health after every 50 enemies defeated.

 - Lu Lingqi

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented Crystal Saplings and other rewards from appearing, sometimes making it impossible to progress.
- Fixed a bug that occurred when playing as Magoichi Saika, in which an unexpectedly large number of attacks would hit enemies if the player evaded immediately after using certain attacks.
- Fixed a bug that prevented some of Ina's Hyper Attacks from being unleashed under certain conditions.
- Fixed a bug preventing the Player Hero Traits for Ling Tong's Unique Weapon from working properly.
- Fixed an error in the description of the Player Hero Traits for Yoshimoto Imagawa's Unique Weapon.
  Before: Replenishes 5% of your Health after every 1,000 enemies defeated.

notes.title: Three characters from the "Atelier" series are joining the battle!
notes.content:
We are proud to release an update for the popular roguelite Warriors action game "WARRIORS: Abyss" (available on PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Nintendo Switch™, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam®) featuring three characters from our “Atelier” series with additional DLC for various costumes, available today March 28th, 2025.

[h3][b]Three characters from the "Atelier" series arrive![/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=tE8H7ry9bGs;full][/previewyoutube]
In this free update, Sophie from the “Atelier Sophie” series, Ryza from “Atelier Ryza” series, and Yumia from “Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land” are added as new heroes. Each hero has their own unique special abilities so depending on your build the range of strategies available to you will expand.

The [b]“Atelier Series Vacation Costume Set"[/b] and the [b]"Atelier Series Academy Costume Set"[/b] are now available. Enjoy battles with a fresh twist, thanks to these unique and vibrant costumes.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.2.0 on Mar. 28, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
- New heroes Sophie, Ryza and Yumia have been added to the game!
- 7 tracks have been added to Music in the Collection, all unlocked from the start.
- We have added a Download Content option to the Great Hall.
- Update information can be viewed from the pause menu.
- At the War Banner of the King where you select heroes for your formation, a boost icon now displays to show which heroes are affected by the currently selected hero's Unique Tactics.
  The boost icon displays yellow for heroes who activate the Unique Tactic and gray for those who do not.
  For example, if your current selection is a hero with the Unique Tactic "Increases Attack by 50% for heroes with the "Wei" Emblem," the boost icon will display for heroes with the Wei Emblem.
- We have adjusted the hero display order in the Hero List tab of the Status Menu. Also, it now shows the slot number of heroes in your Formation.
- We have adjusted the order of Effect Upgrades and Unique Tactics in the Activation Effects tab of the Status Menu. In addition, slot numbers will now be displayed for the Unique Tactics of heroes in your current Formation.
- You can now check information on heroes you added to your Formation from the Formation tab in the Status Menu.
- At the War Banner of the King, we have added an option to revert to the previous Formation after selecting "Enma's Recommended Formation."
- You can now display hero descriptions on the "Select Hero to Play" screen.
- We have added an option allowing players to select their preferred output monitor.
  This setting can be changed under Graphics Settings in the Options menu.

[b]Adjustments/Improvements[/b]
- After using a Crystal Sapling, you can interact with it again if you possess Crystal Beads.
- A treasure chest icon now displays in the top right of the screen in phases where missions appear.
- Music in the Collection now displays the name of the track that is playing.
- When acquiring treasure, you will now see a checkmark displayed by any treasures you have acquired in the past.
- We have adjusted the hero display order in the Play Records screen.
- On the Effect Upgrades screen, the cursor now loops when moved to the top or bottom.
- The effects of the following treasures have been increased:
[quote=author]Cherry Blossom Armor
Bow of Yang Youji
Ranjatai Agarwood
Kompeito
Compass
Four-Wheeled Chariot
Painting of Kannon
Abacus
Bronze Bird[/quote]
- We have increased the amount of extra Karma Embers acquired when playing as a hero in the Bonus State.
- Formations you have not yet unlocked at the Hall of Bonded Souls will appear at the King's Cauldrons in an unpurchasable condition.
- Formations you have unlocked at the Hall of Bonded Souls now appear in treasure chests as rewards for completing missions.
- At Traversal Level 3 and above, Danger Zones now include Sin Spewers, whose projectiles cannot be destroyed with attacks.
- Level boss "Onigashira" now has a smaller barrier gauge.
- Hitting a level boss with a Charge Attack while they are glowing yellow now deals damage to their barrier.
- We have increased the chance of acquiring a Unique Weapon from treasure chests.
- We have adjusted the way Enma's Recommended Formation is calculated.
- We have adjusted the visual effects of Xu Shu and Motonari Mori's summoning skills.
- We have adjusted the screen shake during Cao Ren's Charge Attack 1.
- You can now unleash a Musou Attack during the following attacks:
[quote=author]Lu Meng's Charge Attack 2
Taishi Ci's Charge Attack 2 (2nd hit)
Oichi's Charge Attack 2 (3rd hit)
Tadakatsu Honda's Charge Attack 2 (2nd hit) and Charge Attack 3 (2nd hit)
No's Charge Attack 5 (2nd hit)
Ina's Hyper Attack (derivation 6)
Kanetsugu Naoe's Charge Attack 2
Nene's Charge Attack 2 (2nd hit)
Kiyomasa Kato's Charge Attack 2 (3rd hit)
Naomasa Ii's Charge Attack 2 (2nd hit)[/quote]
- We have reduced the degree to which the following effects contribute to Total Battle Power:
[quote=author]Musou Gauge Charge Amount
Musou Attack Power Increase
Assemble Gauge Charge Amount
Normal Attacks with Attributes
Attack power of Charge Attacks[/quote]
- We have also fixed a bug that prevents you from selecting a Formation when you use "Enma's Recommended Formation" while Total Battle Power exceeds the display limit.
- Under Audio in the Options menu, we have moved the enemy voice category from "Voice Volume" to "SFX Volume."
  We have also made it possible to set louder volumes for "Voice Volume," "SFX Volume" and "BGM Volume." The default volume for these three settings is now set to 80.
  If you feel the background music is too quiet during gameplay, try raising BGM Volume and lowering Voice Volume and SFX Volume.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the application would occasionally crash when playing as Chen Gong.
- Fixed an effect bug that would occur when using Sima Yi's Unique Weapon.
- Fixed the behavior of attacks that diverge from the first part of Kunoichi's Hyper Attack.
- Fixed an issue where the extra damage caused to enemies knocked into the air by Zhang Liao's Unique Weapon was not of the Bolt Attribute as intended.
- Fixed a bug where summoning slot 6 could be used while Lu Lingqi is using Assemble attack.
- Fixed an occasional bug where enemies would enter a formation set up with Xun Yu's Unique Action but take no damage from the attack that causes it to explode after a certain period.
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to use Ma Chao's Charge 5 EX Attack before acquiring the effect "Unlock Attack Actions 3."
- Fixed a bug where performing a Quick Summon while floating with Wang Yuanji's Charge Attack 4 would stop this action.
- Fixed a bug where the spheres of the Protective Star effect would temporarily show up overlapping.
- Fixed a bug where the Protective Star effect would not follow some of the player hero's actions.
- Fixed a bug where Cumulative Level would rise by 1 upon return to the Great Hall, despite having never levelled up once in battle.
- Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented the game from showing up on the main display when launching the application.
- Fixed a bug that occasionally did not display information on top of enemies' head.
- Fixed an error in the effect description of Sima Yi's Unique Weapon in English, French, Italian, German and Spanish.
- Removed an unnecessary part of the Korean description of Liu Bei's Unique Weapon traits.
- Changed the French term for the special emblem "Talent" to "Aptitude."
- Made various other minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.1.0 on Feb. 25, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
- Added the heroes Sima Shi, Sima Zhao, Zhong Hui, Zhang Chunhua, and Wang Yuanji. As a result, Sima Yi's category has been changed to "Jin."
- Added the option "View Available Heroes" when selecting heroes to form alliances with at Crystal Saplings, enabling players to check which heroes might appear when they reroll.
- Made it possible to move to other pages using the left/right inputs in vertical lists.
- Made changes so that characters can now rotate toward the cursor when attacking via mouse click. This feature can be enabled with the "Attack in the direction of the cursor" option in the Controls page of the Options menu.
- Made changes to prevent the cursor from moving outside the game screen.

[b]Adjustments/Improvements[/b]
- Made changes to include attributes (Flame/Ice) for certain Charge Attacks and Musou Attacks from the start for the following heroes: 
Zhou Yu, Sun Jian, Zhuge Liang, Ling Tong, Yukimura Sanada, Shingen Takeda, Hideyoshi Toyotomi, Yoshitomo Imagawa, Ieyasu Tokugawa, Mitsunari Ishida, Katsuie Shibata, Ujiyasu Hojo, Takatora Todo, Nobuyuki Sanada, and Naomasa Ii
- Made adjustments to link follow-up attacks even when evading during Hyper Attacks.
- Adjusted the size of attack indicators for some of Gouma's attacks.
- Made adjustments so that enemies will no longer move during the finishing move of Formation Attacks.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug preventing some of the player hero's attacks from linking together after evading.
- Fixed a bug causing some of the player hero's attacks to disappear when evading.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes shifted character positions when the player hero linked attacks after evading.
- Fixed a bug causing some player hero attacks to continue automatically even without any input after evading.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the camera to jump when the player hero was pushed by an enemy.
- Improved the appearance of the following attacks when playing the Steam version at 30FPS: Gan Ning's Musou Attacks and some of Kanetsugu Naoe's Charge Attacks.
- Fixed a bug preventing attributes temporarily granted to the player hero's normal attacks from being reflected in attack trails.
- Fixed a bug preventing the pulling effect of the upgraded Summoning Skill "Cleaving Blade (Absorb)" or the Summoning Skill "War God's Cry" from being activated when using quick summon.
- Fixed a bug that would temporarily prevent ground-based attacks from landing hits in certain cases when playing the Steam version at 30FPS.
- Fixed a bug causing enemies knocked away during Assemble to become stuck in the ground.
- Fixed a bug in which Zhou Yu's and Katsuie Shibata's Musou Attacks did not stagger enemies.
- Fixed a bug causing Liu Bei's weapon to detach during his EX Attacks.
- Fixed a bug causing Hanbei Takenaka's Normal Attack 6 to be unleashed automatically without any input when the Effect Upgrade "Unlock Attack Actions 2" was activated.
- Fixed a bug preventing summoned soldiers from appearing when Chen Gong's Charge Attack 5 was followed by an evasion and linked EX Attack.
- Fixed a bug preventing the Effect Upgrade "Increase Range" from being applied to the attacks of soldiers summoned by Chen Gong's Charge Attacks.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the explosion from Xun Yu's Charge Attack 1, his Unique Action, from hitting enemies running within the Formation.
- Fixed a bug causing enemies hit by Xun Yu's Charge Attack 1 to move in slow motion.
- Fixed a bug where, if Meng Huo evaded before his weapon shifted into a mushroom during Charge Attack 5, then it would revert to a stone pillar following his linked EX Attack.
- Fixed a bug resulting in unnatural movements for Lu Xun's clone during Charge Attacks.
- Fixed a bug causing the tornado from Hideyoshi Toyotomi's Charge Attack 2 to follow him around.
- Made Xingcai's Charge 5 EX Attack flow more smoothly.
- Fixed a bug where linking an attack after evading at the start of Huang Gai's Charge Attack 6 would result in an attack with no hitbox.
- Fixed a bug causing Dong Zhuo's Summoning Skill "Meteor Strike (Flame)" to appear in the wrong location.
- Fixed a bug causing Mitsuhide Akechi's and Kunoichi's Normal Attack 6 to be unleashed when the Effect Upgrade "Unlock Attack Actions 1" had not been activated.
- Fixed a bug where the Level Boss would occasionally lose sight of the character.
- Fixed a bug where the gameplay records "Unique Weapons Acquired" and "Heroes Who Have Defeated Gouma" did not include heroes made available through DLC.
- Fixed a bug causing heroes made available through DLC to be displayed in gray in the Heroes tab of the gameplay records.
- Fixed a bug where the Unique Tactic for increasing Status Infliction would redundantly affect the Total Battle Power.
- Fixed a bug where acquiring the Effect Upgrade "Double Musou Gauge" did not affect the Total Battle Power.
- Fixed a bug where the background of the results screen would not display correctly.
- Corrected errors in the description of Xiaoqiao's Unique Tactics in French and German.
- Made other minor bug fixes and improvements.
